Activist Shannon O'Loughlin joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 1442 to talk about Native issues. O'Loughlin leads a national group for Native arts and cultures and has worked as a lawyer for tribal causes. Her visit brings policy and history into a studio that rarely hosts either.

She and Rogan discuss tribal rights, the return of remains and sacred objects, and how federal law still shapes Native life. Rogan asks the basic questions many listeners share, and O'Loughlin answers from case work. The episode is a grounded, informative hour on subjects the show usually meets only in passing.
